function.description: Read the contents of a file. Paths are relative to /app/workspace/ (the working directory); the persistent project folder is at project/ (e.g. 'project/src/main.py'). Output is capped at 30KB per file — for larger files use grep to find specific lines, run_shell with `head -c 200000` for a bigger window (200KB), or read_many_files which has the same per-file cap but lets you pull a directory in one call.
function.name: file_read

path.description: Relative path from /app/workspace/. Use 'project/' prefix for the persistent shared project folder.

function.description: Write content to a file. Creates parent directories as needed. Paths are relative to /app/workspace/. Use 'project/' prefix for the persistent shared project folder.
function.name: file_write

path.description: Relative path from /app/workspace/. Use 'project/' prefix for the persistent shared project folder.

function.description: Run a shell command in the workspace directory. Use for tasks like listing files, running builds, etc. stdout+stderr is capped at 200KB; if you need more, pipe through grep/awk/tail to filter at the source (e.g. `go tool cover -func=cov.out | grep ^github.com/myorg/mypkg/`). gcc + libc6-dev are installed so `go test -race` works.
function.name: run_shell

function.description: Return the current date and time in a requested IANA timezone, with UTC included for verification. Use this whenever the task depends on today's date, current time, market hours, deadlines, or timezone conversion. Do not calculate timezone offsets yourself.
function.name: current_time

timezone.description: IANA timezone name such as 'UTC', 'Europe/Prague', 'America/New_York', or 'Asia/Tokyo'. Defaults to UTC.

function.description: Edit a file by replacing an exact string. Prefer this over file_write for modifying existing files — it only sends the diff region and fails fast if old_string is absent or ambiguous. Fails if old_string does not match exactly once (unless replace_all is true). Paths are relative to /app/workspace/ — use 'project/' prefix for the persistent project folder.
function.name: file_edit

new_string.description: Replacement string. May be empty to delete the match.

old_string.description: Exact string to replace. Must match byte-for-byte including whitespace and indentation.

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence instead of requiring exactly one. Default: false.

function.description: Read multiple files in one call. Returns a concatenated blob with '===== FILE: <path> =====' headers per file. Each file is capped at 30KB; total output is capped at 120KB (later files are truncated or dropped). Prefer this over N sequential file_read calls when exploring a directory.
function.name: read_many_files

function.description: Search file contents for a regex pattern. Faster and more token-efficient than run_shell 'grep -r'. Default output is files_with_matches; switch to content mode only when you need line numbers and the matching lines themselves. Results are capped at head_limit lines (default 200) — if a search returns 'truncated' or you want narrower results, supply a more specific pattern, scope via path/glob, or raise head_limit.
function.name: grep

glob.description: Filename glob filter (e.g. '*.go', '**/*.py'). Default: all files.

output_mode.description: files_with_matches (default): paths only. content: matching lines with line numbers. count: per-file match counts.

path.description: Directory to search under. Default: workspace root.

function.description: List files matching a glob pattern. Supports '**' for recursive matching. Faster than run_shell 'find'. Returns paths sorted by modification time (newest first), capped at 500 entries.
function.name: glob

function.description: Show git working-tree status as typed JSON {branch, ahead, behind, files:[{path,status}]}. Use this before committing or when assessing what a prior role changed.
function.name: git_status

function.description: Show a unified diff. Default compares working tree to index (unstaged changes); set staged=true to compare index to HEAD, or revision to diff arbitrary refs.
function.name: git_diff

staged.description: Diff index vs HEAD instead of working tree vs index.

function.description: Show commit history as typed JSON [{sha, short_sha, author, date, subject}]. More token-efficient than parsing run_shell 'git log' output.
function.name: git_log

paths.description: Limit history to commits touching these paths.

function.description: Show a commit's metadata plus its diff. Use when inspecting what a specific commit changed.
function.name: git_show

function.description: Detect project language and run the test suite. Returns {language, runner, passed, failed, skipped, failures:[{test,message}], output}. Gracefully reports when the required toolchain is not installed in the agent image.
function.name: test_run

function.description: Detect project language and run the configured linter (go vet / eslint / ruff). Returns {language, linter, issues:[{file,line,message}], output}.
function.name: lint_run

paths.description: Limit to specific files or packages.

function.description: Detect project language and run type checking (go build / tsc --noEmit / mypy). Returns {language, checker, errors:[{file,line,message}], output}.
function.name: typecheck_run

paths.description: Limit to specific files or packages.

function.description: Record an OFF-SCOPE finding (bug, optimisation opportunity, code inefficiency, refactor candidate) into the project backlog WITHOUT changing any code. Use when you notice something worth fixing that is outside your current task's scope. Never use it for work you are currently assigned.
function.name: backlog_deposit

detail.description: What is wrong / suboptimal and what better looks like

regression.description: Set ONLY when re-reporting a previously-fixed finding that has returned; requires evidence

title.description: Specific, imperative, self-contained (a future task prompt)

function.description: Read the full saved body for a prior compacted tool result by tool_call_id. Use only when the retained head/tail preview is insufficient.
function.name: tool_result_read

tool_call_id.description: The tool_call_id shown in the compacted tool result placeholder.

function.description: Read messages from THIS task's conversation thread. Returns chronological messages (operator + lead exchanges, checkpoints, answers, directives, phase markers). Use this to recall older content the prompt's recent-window may have summarised away.
function.name: get_conversation_window

after.description: Optional cursor: only return messages created after this message ID

kind.description: Optional comma-separated message kinds to filter by (e.g. 'directive,answer')

function.description: Compress a span of older conversation messages into a single 'note' summary that travels with the task. The originals are filtered out of future prompt windows; this summary is shown in their place. You write the summary text yourself — this tool just persists it. Use when the conversation grows long and older details no longer need to be quoted verbatim.
function.name: summarize_thread

messageIds.description: IDs of messages this summary covers (the originals are hidden from future prompt windows)

summary.description: The summary text. One paragraph; cap 4 KB.

function.description: Fetch the full instructions of a learned skill listed in the LEARNED SKILLS index of your system prompt. Call this BEFORE doing work a listed skill covers, then follow the returned instructions.
function.name: skill_fetch

name.description: Exact skill name as shown in the LEARNED SKILLS index

function.description: Call an authenticated third-party API through the vornik gateway. The daemon injects the provider credential server-side — NEVER put API keys, tokens, or secrets in the arguments. Use list_apis first to discover available providers. Responses are redacted and size-capped by the daemon.
function.name: query_api

body.description: Optional request body as a JSON object (for write methods)

method.description: HTTP method (default GET). Writes are refused for agents unless the role is explicitly granted write access.

provider.description: Provider id as shown by list_apis (e.g. 'maps')

query.description: Optional query-string parameters as a JSON object

function.description: List the third-party API providers reachable from this project via the vornik gateway, with the paths/methods each allows. Call before query_api to discover the correct provider id and path.
function.name: list_apis

query.description: Optional filter to narrow the provider list
